scenario.name: OSPF authentication key mismatch after key rotation
scenario.description: An OSPF message-digest key rotation on CORE-RTR-02 leaves the Bengaluru adjacency down while the WAN circuit stays up; Bengaluru devices also drop out of monitoring.

incident.title: Bengaluru office offline; carrier says the circuit is healthy
incident.description: Bengaluru users lost ERP, DHCP renewals and internet. Monitoring shows the Bengaluru devices as not responding, yet the carrier reports the WAN circuit is up and error free.
symptoms: Bengaluru devices not responding to monitoring

ground_truth.root_cause: A message-digest key rotation on CORE-RTR-02 Gi0/0/2 removed key 1 and introduced key 2, which BLR-RTR-01 does not have; hellos are rejected on both sides, the OSPF area 10 adjacency over LNK-WAN-BLR is down and all routes between Bengaluru and the core were withdrawn.
